source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: Bylo 4:30 italského času. Cohren nesnášel to vstávání. Hlavně proto, že to byl právě on, kdo byl zodpovědný za vzbuzení ostatních členů své jednotky. Tichými kroky vystoupil ze své postele, oblékl si bojový oděv, hodil si na sebe taktickou vestu a začal balit si věci ze své skříňky. S jednou malou krabičkou byl velmi opatrný. Do ruky si vzal pušku, helmu pověsil na malý háček připevněný k opasku. Na helmě bylo všechno, čeho by mohl potřebovat. Dýchačka, brýle, všechno potřebné. Po kontrole nábojů tiše vyšel z kasáren, kde bláto a led pod nohama skřípaly.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: Cohren nesnášel vstávat takhle brzy ráno. Hlavně proto, že to bylo jeho povinností vzbudit všechny ostatní ve své společnosti. Potichu vstal z postele, oblékl si bojové oblečení, přes rameno si hodil útočnou vestu a sbalil si věci ze své skříňky, opatrně s jednou malou krabičkou. Přes rameno si hodil pušku a na malý hák na pásku připevnil helmu. Měla všechna svá upevnění, dýchací přístroj, brýle, vše potřebné. Poté, co zkontroloval zásobníky, tiše vyšel z kasáren, bláto a led pod jeho botami křupaly.

I noticed Al inside, chained. Figures he’d get caught eventually.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.

Tiše vstal z postele, oblékl si bojovou uniformu, přehodil přes sebe útočnou vestu a z kufru ve skříni si vybalil věci, přičemž si dával pozor na jednu malou krabičku. source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: Bylo 4:30 italského času. Cohren nesnášel to vstávání. Hlavně proto, že to byl právě on, kdo byl zodpovědný za vzbuzení ostatních členů své jednotky. Tichými kroky vystoupil ze své postele, oblékl si bojový oděv, hodil si na sebe taktickou vestu a začal balit si věci ze své skříňky. S jednou malou krabičkou byl velmi opatrný. Do ruky si vzal pušku, helmu pověsil na malý háček připevněný k opasku. Na helmě bylo všechno, čeho by mohl potřebovat. Dýchačka, brýle, všechno potřebné. Po kontrole nábojů tiše vyšel z kasáren, kde bláto a led pod nohama skřípaly.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
